production.note: Calendar years. BMW Group Classic: "1978 - 1981". BMW press release (bmw-us-m1-30-years): 1978–1981, 445 built in total, 399 of them road cars.

body.note: Mid-engined two-seat coupe with spaceframe and plastic body.

aspiration.note: "four valves per cylinder and mechanical injection"; no forced induction.

drivetrain.note: Mid-engine with ZF transaxle driving the rear wheels.

transmission.note: "ZF five-speed manual gearbox with integrated final drive"; Evo: "ZF five-speed manual, 40 per cent LSD".

powerHp.note: BMW's rating of 277 PS (204 kW) at 6,500 rpm x 0.98632 = 273 hp (204 kW x 1.34102 = 274 hp). Quote (BMW Group Classic): "277 hp (204 kW) at 6500 rpm"; quote (BMW press release, bmw-us-m1-30-years): "204 kW (277 bhp)". The kW figure shows the 277 is PS. Evo's panel (evo-bmw-m1): "Max power: 273bhp @ 6500rpm".

weightLb.note: Evo specification panel (step 2): 1,300 kg x 2.20462 = 2,866 lb. Quote: "Weight (kerb): 1300kg". No BMW weight for the road car was found on the pages opened (the BMW release gives only the Procar's 1,020 kg).

sources.publisher: BMW of North America (BMW Group PressClub USA)
